title: Share repurchase
extract: Share repurchase, also known as share buyback or stock buyback, is the reacquisition by a company of its own shares. It is an alternative way of returning money to shareholders than dividends. After a repurchase event, the company's stock price is now proportionally higher because of the smaller number of shares outstanding. Repurchases allow stockholders to potentially reduce taxes, by paying the usually lower capital gains tax when the shareholder chooses to sell the stock rather than the higher ordinary income tax rate that must be paid when the dividends are distributed.
